examples.en: My first job was working at the Ukiah Library when I was 16 years old. It was a dream job and I did everything from shelving books to reading to the children for story time.
examples.zh: 我的第一份工作是16岁时在尤基亚图书馆工作。那是一份理想的工作，我做过很多事情，从整理书籍到给孩子们读故事不等。

examples.en: A park ranger in Ukiah, California, gave me some carrots.
examples.zh: 在加利福尼亚的尤凯亚，一位停车场管理员我一些胡萝卜。

examples.en: With prior arrangements, we can usually arrange for someone to pick you up at the Ukiah Greyhound station or Ukiah Airport.
examples.zh: 如果事先安排，我们通常可以派人到瑜伽市灰狗巴士车站或瑜伽市机场接您。
